{{Youmay|the profession|the [[Nerf Herder|comic]]}}
[[File:Nerf-aa.jpg|thumb|200px|A nerf herder keeps watch over a herd of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]].]]
{{Quote|Why, you low-down, stuck-up, half-witted, scruffy-looking nerf-herder&hellip;''"<br />"''Who's scruffy-looking?|Princess Leia Organa and Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back (novel)">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''nerf herder''', also spelled "'''nerf-herder'''" or "'''nerfherder'''," was someone who herded [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As it was perceived as an occupation for lower-class beings, the term "nerf herder" became an insult used throughout the galaxy. Nerf herders were often somewhat simple, but as a result of living outdoors and fighting off anything that interfered with their herds, they became quite capable.

The corresponding adjective for the insult "nerf herder" was "'''nerf-herding'''"; when [[Salla Zend]] was reunited with her former lover [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], she referred to him as a "nerf-herdin' son of a —,"<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo|Leia]] once thought of Solo as a "nerf-herding [[Laserbrain/Legends|laserbrain]]."<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

[[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]] on the inside of the entrance to the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] in the [[79's/Legends|79's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] said "[[Grievous/Legends|GRIEVOUS]] IS A NERFHERDER".<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Wikipedia:Nerf Herder|pop-punk band]] derived its name from this phrase.
